description: Checks whether a claim in England and Wales normally goes to the small claims track (CPR 26.9 to 26.12: £10,000; personal injury limits for pain, suffering and loss of amenity; housing disrepair with an order for repairs; never harassment or unlawful eviction) and adds up what CPR 27.14(2) allows on your figures: the Table 2 fixed issue costs, court fees paid, reasonable travel, lost earnings up to £95 a day for each person, experts up to £750 each, up to £260 for advice on an injunction or specific performance claim, and an appeal transcript. Optionally it also covers the small claims mediation pilot (PD 51ZE: claims issued from 22 May 2024 to 6 April 2027) and the costs of refusing ADR (Churchill v Merthyr Tydfil; CPR 44.2(5)(e)), and a small claims appeal: the route, permission, the N164 and its 21-day deadline, and the fee. Allocation is the court's decision, and further costs for unreasonable behaviour are for the court: never estimated.

adrRefused.description: A party refused or ignored an invitation to use ADR, or did not comply with an order to use it.

advice.description: With injunction: legal advice on that claim (capped at £260), in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

appealFrom.description: Optional, for an appeal: who made the small claims decision: "dj" (a District Judge or deputy), "cj" (a Circuit Judge or Recorder).

claimed.description: Claimant: the amount claimed on the claim form, for the fixed issue costs, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

courtFees.description: Court fees actually paid, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

decided.description: Optional, for an appeal: the date of the decision (the hearing at which it was made) (YYYY-MM-DD).

earnings.description: Lost earnings or leave, one entry per person per day (each capped at £95), each in pounds, e.g. ["120", "95.50"]. In a query string, leave out thousands separators.

experts.description: Experts' fees, one entry per expert (each capped at £750), each in pounds, e.g. ["120", "95.50"]. In a query string, leave out thousands separators.

extraDefendants.description: Further defendants personally served at separate addresses: a whole number, e.g. "1".

injunction.description: The claim includes an injunction or specific performance.

issued.description: Optional: the date the claim was issued, for the PD 51ZE small claims mediation pilot (YYYY-MM-DD).

kind.description: The kind of claim, for the track: "general" (a money claim or other claim, not personal injury or disrepair), "disrepair" (housing disrepair: a tenant's claim), "pi-rta" (personal injury: a road traffic accident), "pi-other" (personal injury: anything else), "eviction" (a tenant's claim for harassment or unlawful eviction).

missedMediation.description: A party did not attend the Small Claims Mediation Service appointment.

ocmc.description: The claim was started in Online Civil Money Claims.

otherDamages.description: "disrepair": the other damages claimed, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

personalService.description: The claim form was served personally by the claimant.

piBefore2022.description: "pi-other": the cause of action accrued before 6 April 2022.

psla.description: Personal injury: damages for pain, suffering and loss of amenity, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

repairs.description: "disrepair": the estimated cost of the repairs, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

repairsOrder.description: "disrepair": the tenant seeks an order for repairs (default true).

represented.description: The claimant has a solicitor (default true), for the fixed issue costs.

roadTraffic.description: A money claim from a road traffic accident with no injury claimed (referred to mediation only if started in Online Civil Money Claims).

rtaChildWhiplash.description: "pi-rta": a child or protected party with a whiplash injury, accident on or after 31 May 2021.

rtaSpecial.description: "pi-rta": an accident before 31 May 2021, or a claimant in a CPR 26.10 group (cyclist, pedestrian, motorcyclist and so on).

specifiedOnly.description: The only remedy claimed is a specified sum of money (the PD 51ZE pilot covers only those claims).

transcript.description: On an appeal: an approved transcript, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

travel.description: Reasonable travel and overnight expenses for attending a hearing, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

unreasonable.description: The court found a party behaved unreasonably (CPR 27.14(2)(g)).

value.description: The value of the claim (personal injury: the total); for "disrepair", only where no order for repairs is sought, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

who.description: Who is claiming the costs, for what can be recovered.

name: check_small_claims_costs
title: Small claims costs checker (CPR 26.9 and 27.14)
